title: Fantastic Views and Igor is a Gem!
text:
Wow! This was an adventure we'll never forget! Our guide was Igor and he is an absolute treasure of Viator. This experience was harder than we expected but he was so pleasant and helpful that we were able to ride the bikes all the way up to Tibidabo Mountain where the views of Barcelona can't be beat. Igor was full of interesting facts, took us by several points of interest and let us stop along the way for photos. It was amazing!

That being said, know that this experience is harder than what Viator notes. You must be in good physical shape and be prepared to ride bikes in traffic, around peo
author: Julia_C
